description:
The Collaboration Platform for API Development

Postman is a collaboration platform for API development. Postman's features simplify each step of building an API and streamline collaboration so you can create better APIs — faster.
What’s New
The Postman CLI is included with the Postman app
When you install or update the Postman app, the Postman CLI is now installed with it. You can use Postman from your terminal and from coding agents without a separate download.
